Privacy

8-bit Bootcamp. Updated 19 November 2026.

Back to the game · Terms of use

On this device

Your recruit name, appearance, stats, and progress stay in this browser. The game stores them in local storage under bootcamp-save-0, bootcamp-save-1, bootcamp-save-2, and bootcamp-meta. Clearing site data deletes those saves. The game does not upload them.

The game does not use tracking cookies and does not show ads.

Counts that may leave the device

The game sends cookieless counts to Umami. A visit includes the page address, browser, and country. Umami does not use cookies. The game also sends two events:

  • play — the game was opened. This includes the build id.
  • error — the page hit an uncaught error. The count includes a short error message (about 150 characters), the campaign id, the activity id, and the build id.

Those events do not include your recruit name, stats, appearance, save file, or stack trace. Nothing is sent from this browser after you turn counts off below. We do not sell this information.

This browser

That choice is stored in local storage as bootcamp-telemetry and umami.disabled. Neither is a cookie.

Children

Do not type a real child’s name into the recruit screen. Names stay on the device, and the counts above are not tied to an account.
